Patch tests are an easy way to ensure you don't experience any initial negative reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test prior to starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps: Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow 2. Keep the area dry 3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or lesser if the product isn’t a leave-on product) 4. If any redness, itching or irritation is observed at any time during the test do not use the product, else you can safely use it Safe & Effective Paraben Free Silicone Free Aluminium free Mineral Free Petroleum Free Phthalate Free Questions you should be asking. Answers that we believe must be heard. Frequently asked questions About 6% AHA BHA Underarm Roll On for Women What is the difference between a deodorant and an antiperspirant? Deodrants directly fight sweat-causing bacteria. Antiperspirants contain actives which reduce sweat by clogging sweat pores. These pores get unclogged naturally due to the skin renewal process. Will it leave patches on clothes? No, if you allow the product to absorb before wearing clothes, it won't leave patches. Can I use it directly post-waxing? We'd suggest keeping a gap of 6-12 hours to use this deodrant post waxing. How much time will it take to see results? We recommend checking with the doctor as results will vary depending on the condition: however you should start noticing a change within 3 months Can I use this product twice a day? Yes, you can use this product on clean skin, daily, twice a day.
